source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (non-standard employment, less than 5 hours per day, earns less than R394 that day: 25% deduction)
notes: Casual daily-paid worker, 4 hours a day at R300 a day for 15 days = R4 500: 60 hours a month is about 13.9 hours a week (under 22), no written declaration, and under 5 hours a day, so the deemed-standard route does not apply: non-standard employment, 25% of the balance of remuneration = R1 125.00 (G21 p. 28, summary table row 5). The tables give nil. Only PAYE is asserted. Confidence MEDIUM-HIGH: row 5 follows from the two-limb reading of the deemed-standard bullet below and is not a misprint. G21 p. 28 reading used by all the ts-* cases: the deemed-standard bullet has two limbs, (1) under 22 hours a week with a written declaration of no other employer, and (2) at least 5 hours a day and paid under R394 a day, read as an alternative route to deemed standard; the summary-table rows for non-standard employment follow from that (row 5, under 5 hours a day and under R394, is the residual non-standard case taxed at 25%, not a misprint). TS-b must wire taxStatus and the hours into runCase (oracle.ts hard-codes employmentType permanent and passes no taxStatus or unmodelled input today, so this case cannot see them); once wired, this case must go red if the status is ignored if the status is ignored.
